description: Review and testimonial cards for plumbing and HVAC contractors.

entries.author: Sample entry
entries.text: Water heater died on a Sunday. They answered, showed up in two hours, and had hot water back the same night.

entries.author: Sample entry
entries.text: Quoted me over the phone, charged me what they quoted, and left the basement cleaner than they found it.

entries.text: AC quit during the heat wave. Technician explained the repair, fixed it once, and it has run cold ever since.

entries.text: Third plumber we called, first one who actually found the leak. Honest work, fair price, no scare tactics.
